reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Eric Glyman, co-founder and CEO of Ramp.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Eric Glyman, co-founder and CEO of Ramp. Ramp is best known for its corporate cards but it has a range of software products to help finance teams save money and time. Since its founding in 2019, the business has grown rapidly and was last valued at $8 billion.

key_points.text: Eric and I discuss Ramp’s initial marketing wedge, how the business has dealt with such fast growth.
Please enjoy my conversation with Eric Glyman.
